name: Aardwolf EQ Search
author: Solao
description: 'search all' and 'eqsearch all' in a panel of their own, fresh each run, colours intact.
script:
--[[ aw-eqsearch.lua Sean Stoves (Solao) â€” 2026-08-06 'search all' and 'eqsearch all' copied into a panel of their own, fresh every run, with the MUD's colours intact. Ported from the Mudlet searchwin. There is no tag for this â€” Aardwolf's telnet channel 102 carries options for helpfiles, the map, channels and a dozen other things, and nothing for search â€” so it is read off the output, which is fixed-width and announces itself: Finding best searchable items for all equipment slots: Item Current New Wear Loc New Item Level Location Points Points -------- ---------------------------- ----- --------- ------- ------ Light Bioluminescence of Iviruan 171 Seekers 220 315 ... Note: * Searchable item list is only a small portion of game items. The announcement line is skipped: you know what you ran. The Note block is the MUD's standing advice, the same three lines every time, and it ends the table. Blank lines go too â€” the table has no blank rows inside it, so dropping every blank leaves the header, the rule and the rows exactly. The prompt is the backstop behind Note, because Note is wording the MUD can change while hp/mn/mv in brackets is structural. Nothing is gagged by default. This is a copy, not a move. Two things differ from the Mudlet build. It scrolls rather than pages â€” Mudlet paged because a scrolled console splits into two panes with a divider, which is right for a MUD window and wrong for a document, and a div has no such problem. And the capture trigger is registered once at load and switched on, never created when the block starts: a trigger created inside a callback does not see the rest of the packet it was created in, and this whole report arrives in one. ]] plugin = { id = "aw-eqsearch", name = "Aardwolf EQ Search", version = "1.1.0", author = "Solao", description = "'search all' and 'eqsearch all' in a panel of their own, fresh each run, colours intact.", settings = { saveState = true }, } --[[ Drop every handler already on a widget event. Looked up through _G rather than called by name: a global this build does not have throws on the way IN, before pcall can catch anything, so a bare reference would take the plugin down on any client that lacks it. ]] local function drop_handlers(id, event) local ok, fn = pcall(function() return _G["unregisterWidgetEvent"] end) if ok and type(fn) == "function" then pcall(fn, id, event) end end -- @category widgets local TAG = "$Y[EQ Search v" .. plugin.version .. "]$w " local TAGR = "$R[EQ Search v" .. plugin.version .. "]$w " local MAX_ROWS = 200 -- a search all is about 20; this is a runaway guard local cfg = { on = true, gag = false, -- a copy by default; the report still scrolls past fpx = 0, -- suite font px from Core's "aw-font" broadcast; 0 = unset fov = 0, -- this panel's own font px; 0 = follow the suite } --[[ The panel's base font size in px, carried as an inline style on the root div so a plain repaint applies it. The stylesheet is em fractions of this. MudForge's own font controls cannot reach a plugin iframe - see the full note in aw-vitals.lua. '/awcore font' scales every panel; '/awsearch font' overrides it here. ]] local function font_base() if cfg.fov >= 6 and cfg.fov <= 48 then return cfg.fov end if cfg.fpx >= 6 and cfg.fpx <= 48 then return cfg.fpx end return 10 end local widget = nil local view = "list" -- "list" | "settings" local lines = {} -- the last report, raw, escapes intact local buf = {} -- the one being captured local capturing = false local rowTrig = nil local stopTimer = nil local function trim(s) return (string.gsub(tostring(s or ""), "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")) end local function esc(s) s = tostring(s or "") s = string.gsub(s, "&", "&") s = string.gsub(s, "<", "<") s = string.gsub(s, ">", ">") return s end --[[ The Aardwolf prompt, found by plain text rather than a pattern. Mudlet matched '%d+/%d+hp', and %d is a Lua class â€” on this client those run through a JavaScript regex engine where it means nothing, so the match would quietly never fire and the capture would run until its timeout on every single search. hp, mn and mv together are structural: they have been on the prompt for as long as the game has existed, and no row of a search table carries all three. ]] local function is_prompt(line) return string.find(line, "hp ", 1, true) ~= nil and string.find(line, "mn ", 1, true) ~= nil and string.find(line, "mv ", 1, true) ~= nil end --- -- paint --- local CSS_HEAD = [==[ â€” rather than by splicing rules into a literal that already carries its own closing tag. The ASCII map panel builds its stylesheet this way and its colours work; the chat panel spliced and the generated rule rendered as literal text. ]] local function css_for() local seen, out, n = {}, {}, 0 for _, line in ipairs(lines) do local ok, segs = pcall(parseAnsiText, line) if ok and type(segs) == "table" then for _, seg in pairs(segs) do if type(seg) == "table" and type(seg.color) == "string" then local hex = string.match(seg.color, "^#%x%x%x%x%x%x$") -- black means "no colour set", not "paint it black"; a -- search table on this panel would vanish if hex and hex ~= "#000000" and not seen[hex] then n = n + 1 seen[hex] = "s" .. n table.insert(out, " .arc-s ." .. seen[hex] .. " { color: " .. hex .. "; }") end end end end end return CSS_HEAD .. table.concat(out, "\n") .. "\n\n", seen end local function render() if not widget then return end local css, cls = css_for() --[[ Hide first, gear hard right â€” the order the shop panel uses and the one every panel here settled on. A control that moves between panels is a control people stop trusting. ]] local bar = 'EQ Search' .. ((#lines > 0) and ('' .. #lines .. ' line(s)') or "") .. '' .. '
hide
' .. '
' .. (view ~= "list" and "◀ back" or "⚙") .. '
' local body if view == "settings" then body = '
Capture
' .. '
' .. '
' .. (cfg.on and "on" or "off") .. '
' .. '
' .. 'hide output
' .. '
' .. '
Run search all or ' .. 'eqsearch all as you always have. Hide output keeps ' .. 'the report out of the terminal so only this panel shows it; otherwise ' .. 'it scrolls past there too and this is a copy that stays put.
' elseif #lines == 0 then body = '
Run search all or ' .. 'eqsearch all.
' else local out = {} for _, line in ipairs(lines) do local ok, segs = pcall(parseAnsiText, line) if not ok or type(segs) ~= "table" then table.insert(out, esc(line)) else local row = "" for _, seg in pairs(segs) do if type(seg) == "table" and type(seg.text) == "string" then local hex = (type(seg.color) == "string") and string.match(seg.color, "^#%x%x%x%x%x%x$") or nil local k = hex and cls[hex] or nil if k then row = row .. '' .. esc(seg.text) .. "" else row = row .. esc(seg.text) end end end table.insert(out, row) end end body = "
" .. table.concat(out, "\n") .. "
" end setWidgetProperty(widget, "content", css .. '
' .. '
' .. bar .. '
' .. '
' .. body .. '
') end --- -- capture --- local function stop() capturing = false if rowTrig then pcall(disableTrigger, rowTrig) end if stopTimer then pcall(removeTimer, stopTimer); stopTimer = nil end end local function finish() stop() lines = buf buf = {} render() showWidget(widget) pcall(setWidgetAppearance, widget, { zIndex = 9999 }) end local function on_start() if not cfg.on then return end stop() buf = {} capturing = true if rowTrig then pcall(enableTrigger, rowTrig) end -- a search that never reaches a prompt would otherwise capture the session stopTimer = addTimer(15000, function() if capturing then finish() utilprint(TAGR .. "no prompt arrived - stopped capturing.") end end) -- the announcement is not the report; you know what you ran if cfg.gag then return false end end local function on_row(c, line, w, raw) if not capturing then return end local text = (type(raw) == "string" and raw ~= "") and raw or tostring(line or "") local plain = tostring(line or "") -- the prompt is not ours to take; stop in front of it if is_prompt(plain) then finish() return end --[[ The Note block is the MUD's standing advice about searchable items, the same three lines every run, and it ends the table. ]] if string.find(trim(plain), "Note:", 1, true) == 1 then finish() return end -- no blank rows inside the table, so dropping every blank leaves the -- header, the rule and the rows and nothing else if trim(plain) == "" then if cfg.gag then return false end return end if #buf < MAX_ROWS then table.insert(buf, text) end if cfg.gag then return false end end --- -- setup --- local function save_cfg() saveTable("aw_eqsearch", cfg) end function init() widget = createWidget({ type = "html", name = "search", title = "EQ Search", position = { x = 150, y = 90 }, size = { width = 720, height = 420 }, visible = false, -- put up by running a search and by nothing else appearance = { showTitleBar = false, autoHideSettingsCog = true, zIndex = 9999, }, }) local saved = loadTable("aw_eqsearch") if type(saved) == "table" then if saved.on == false then cfg.on = false end if saved.gag == true then cfg.gag = true end local fp = tonumber(saved.fpx) if fp and fp >= 6 and fp <= 48 then cfg.fpx = math.floor(fp) end fp = tonumber(saved.fov) if fp and fp >= 6 and fp <= 48 then cfg.fov = math.floor(fp) end end -- the suite font size, from Core ('/awcore font'); "0" means unset onPluginBroadcast(function(senderId, message, data) if tostring(message or "") ~= "aw-font" then return end local px = tonumber(data) px = (px and px >= 6 and px <= 48) and math.floor(px) or 0 if px == cfg.fpx then return end cfg.fpx = px save_cfg() render() end) --[[ Registered once and left disabled, then switched on for the block. A trigger CREATED when the report starts would not see the rest of the packet it was created in, and the whole report arrives in one â€” which is how the loot tracker came to store every identify under an undefined name. ]] rowTrig = addTrigger("*", on_row, { type = "wildcard", priority = 1, keepEvaluating = true, enabled = false, }) addTrigger("^Finding best searchable items", on_start, { type = "regex", priority = 80 }) --[[ Clear first. init() runs again on every hot-reload and registerWidgetEvent APPENDS â€” so each reload stacks another handler on the same widget and one click fires all of them. It shows up as buttons sending their command two, three, five times, getting worse the longer a session goes on, and nothing about it looks like a plugin bug from the outside. unregisterWidgetEvent with no callback drops every handler for the event, which is exactly what a fresh init wants. ]] drop_handlers(widget, "action") registerWidgetEvent(widget, "action", function(data) if type(data) ~= "table" then return end local act = tostring(data.action or "") if act == "close" then hideWidget(widget) return elseif act == "view" then -- anything that isn't the report goes back to it view = (view ~= "list") and "list" or "settings" elseif act == "on" then cfg.on = not cfg.on save_cfg() if not cfg.on then stop() end elseif act == "gag" then cfg.gag = not cfg.gag save_cfg() end render() end) render() --[[ NOT "search", and not "eqsearch" either. registerCommand intercepts the bare word, so a command named 'search' swallows the MUD's own 'search all' and answers with this plugin's help instead of running the search. Both names belong to the game; the panel gets a name that doesn't. ]] registerCommand("awsearch", function(args) local a = args if type(a) == "table" then a = table.concat(a, " ") end a = string.lower(trim(a)) if a == "" or a == "show" then showWidget(widget) render() elseif a == "hide" then hideWidget(widget) elseif a == "on" or a == "off" then cfg.on = (a == "on") save_cfg() if not cfg.on then stop() end utilprint(TAG .. (cfg.on and "'search all' is copied to the panel." or "main window only.")) elseif a == "gag" then cfg.gag = not cfg.gag save_cfg() render() utilprint(TAG .. (cfg.gag and "panel only - the report is hidden from the main window." or "the report prints in both places.")) elseif a == "clear" then lines = {} render() utilprint(TAG .. "cleared.") elseif string.match(a, "^font") then local how = string.match(a, "^font%s+(%S+)$") or "" local n = tonumber(how) if how == "auto" or how == "off" then cfg.fov = 0 elseif n and n >= 6 and n <= 48 then cfg.fov = math.floor(n) else utilprint(TAG .. "usage: /awsearch font <6-48> | auto") return end save_cfg() render() utilprint(TAG .. "font " .. (cfg.fov >= 6 and (cfg.fov .. "px for this panel.") or "follows the suite (/awcore font).")) else utilprint(TAG .. "'search all' in a panel of its own, fresh each run.") utilprint("$w /awsearch show the panel") utilprint("$w /awsearch hide put it away") utilprint("$w /awsearch on | off copy the report, or don't") utilprint("$w /awsearch gag hide it from the main window") utilprint("$w /awsearch font |auto this panel's text size") utilprint("$w /awsearch clear empty it") utilprint(TAG .. "state: " .. (cfg.on and "on" or "off") .. ", " .. (cfg.gag and "panel only" or "printed in both") .. ", " .. #lines .. " line(s) held.") utilprint("$K Run 'search all' or 'eqsearch all' as you always have.$w") end end, "'search all' in its own panel, fresh each run") end --[[ A reload would otherwise strand the wildcard trigger. It is registered disabled, so a stranded one is harmless until something enables it â€” but there would then be two, and the second would never be switched off. ]] function cleanup() if rowTrig then pcall(removeTrigger, rowTrig); rowTrig = nil end if stopTimer then pcall(removeTimer, stopTimer); stopTimer = nil end end
